payload.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Software Engineer based in the United States.
We are looking for an early-career software engineer to build internal applications, automations, and AI-powered tools that help teams work more efficiently. You will collaborate directly with colleagues across departments to understand their workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and turn ideas into practical technology solutions. From custom applications and business system integrations to intelligent agents and automated processes, your work will have a direct impact on day-to-day operations. You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from discovery and planning to testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Working alongside experienced IT and engineering professionals, you will have opportunities to take ownership of your projects and grow your technical responsibilities. This is a fully remote role designed for someone curious, resourceful, and excited to explore emerging technologies
Accountabilities
Develop projects from an internal innovation backlog, contributing to project definition, scope, sprint planning, delivery, launch, and performance measurement.
Build and maintain internal applications supporting departments such as finance, contracts, and human resources.
Improve existing low-code solutions by transitioning workflows into custom applications when greater flexibility or functionality is needed.
Create and maintain integrations between business systems to improve data flow and reduce manual processes.
Collaborate with IT colleagues to automate operational tasks, including account provisioning, employee offboarding, Google Workspace administration, and reporting.
Conduct user acceptance testing with the teams who will use each application, ensuring solutions work effectively in real-world scenarios before launch.
Deliver software through GitHub-based workflows, incorporating code reviews, continuous integration, automated tests, and release runbooks.
Develop AI-powered features, agents, and automations using large language model (LLM) APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Help evaluate AI models and development tools, recommend appropriate solutions, and contribute to responsible and secure AI adoption.
Measure the impact of AI solutions against existing manual processes and identify opportunities to improve productivity.
Support colleagues in adopting AI tools through training sessions, written guidance, and individual assistance.
Meet with employees and department leaders to understand their workflows, identify bottlenecks, and translate operational challenges into clearly scoped technical projects.
Explore emerging technologies and propose practical improvements to internal processes and systems.
Contribute to the development of future application architecture, including shared data structures, authentication, and integrations with business systems.
Provide support for escalated IT issues when operational demand requires additional assistance.
Take ownership of applications over time, managing their roadmaps, gathering user feedback, and driving continuous improvement.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
0–2 years of professional software development experience; internships and substantial personal or academic projects are considered relevant.
Working proficiency in at least one of the following: TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python.
Demonstrated experience building an application, tool, or automation that has been used by other people.
Working knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, Git, and the Linux command line.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to understand how teams operate, identify inefficient workflows, and develop practical solutions.
Self-motivation and the ability to organize work independently in a fully remote environment.
Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new technologies and development practices.
Familiarity with Google Cloud or another major cloud platform, as well as Docker, is an advantage.
Experience with Next.js or React is preferred.
Exposure to workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Make.com, or Google Apps Script is beneficial.
Familiarity with LLM APIs, AI agents, MCP servers, or AI-assisted coding tools is a plus.
Knowledge of Google Workspace administration or GAM is advantageous.
Previous IT support experience is beneficial.
Experience delivering user training or conducting user acceptance testing is a plus.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
Benefits
Annual base salary ranging from $75,000 to $90,000, depending on skills, experience, qualifications, education, and other relevant factors.
Fully remote work arrangement within the United States.
Choice of medical plans, including HSA and PPO options, with company contributions.
Dental and vision coverage for employees and their families.
Company-paid life insurance and short-term and long-term disability coverage.
Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness insurance.
401(k) retirement plan with company match.
Paid time off that increases with years of service, plus paid federal holidays.
Paid industry certifications and professional development opportunities.
Access to an internal training and learning portal.
Flexible spending accounts.
Wellness and fitness program.
Employee referral bonuses.
Opportunities to take ownership of applications, expand technical responsibilities, and contribute to application architecture and AI development strategy.
How Jobgether Works
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Junior to Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer (Mobile & Web)
About The Role
We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled Junior to Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer - Mobile & Web to join a fast-growing European startup connecting students and flexible workers with local businesses in Belgium.
The ideal candidate has practical experience developing web and mobile applications using Node.js, Nest.js, React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and React Native . You will work closely with senior developers and international stakeholders to build features, improve existing functionality, integrate third-party services, and maintain a robust platform. This role suits an ambitious developer eager to grow into a senior engineering position within a product-focused Agile environment.
Experience: 2–4 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Timings: 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Monday to Friday)
Location: Model Town, Lahore, Pakistan
Industry: Technology / SaaS / HR Tech Salary Range: 170K PKR - 220K PKR
Key Responsibilities
Full-Stack Development: Develop, maintain, and enhance web and mobile applications using Node.js, Nest.js, React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and React Native.
Frontend & UI: Build reusable frontend components and responsive, user-friendly interfaces.
API & Security: Develop and integrate secure REST APIs; implement authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC under technical guidance.
Database Management: Work with SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis); assist with queries, indexing, schema design, and caching.
Mobile Development: Develop and maintain React Native features for iOS and Android deployment.
Integrations: Integrate third-party services such as payments, notifications, payroll, e-signing, and identity verification.
Quality Assurance & Testing: Troubleshoot bugs across frontend, backend, and mobile; write clean, maintainable code alongside unit and integration tests.
Collaboration & Agile Workflow: Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and daily stand-ups; estimate tasks, communicate blockers clearly, and coordinate with QA teams prior to release.
Modern Tooling & AI Assistance: Use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) responsibly while reviewing and validating generated code.
Operations: Assist with deployments, system configuration, and technical documentation.
Required Qualifications & Experience
Professional Experience: 2–4 years of software development experience, preferably in a full-stack capacity.
Backend Proficiency: Hands-on commercial experience with Node.js and familiarity with Nest.js.
Frontend Proficiency: Practical experience with React.js and familiarity with Next.js.
Core Languages & Web Standards: Strong knowledge of TypeScript, modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.
APIs & Security: Experience developing and consuming REST APIs with a solid understanding of JWT, OAuth, and RBAC.
Databases: Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases; hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL, and familiarity with MongoDB and Redis.
Mobile Experience: At least 1 year of hands-on React Native experience building mobile apps for iOS and Android.
Engineering Fundamentals: Understanding of asynchronous programming, API integration, Git workflows, debugging, error handling, and basic system architecture.
Cloud & Security: Basic understanding of application security, performance optimization, and cloud platforms (AWS or DigitalOcean).
Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with comfort collaborating in a distributed international team environment.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
AI & Modern Development Practices
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.
Ability to leverage AI for coding, debugging, and documentation while maintaining a strict commitment to clean, secure, and well-tested code.
Nice-to-Have Skills
Production experience with Nest.js and publishing React Native apps to Google Play and the Apple App Store.
Familiarity with microservices, WebSockets, real-time features, queues, and background jobs.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and DigitalOcean Kubernetes (DOKS).
Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest or React Testing Library.
Understanding of GDPR and data privacy compliance practices.
Background in SaaS, HR tech, startups, or distributed remote teams.
What You'll Gain
Hands-on production experience scaling a European HR Tech platform.
Exposure to complex third-party integrations, high-performance APIs, and modern backend architecture.
Direct mentorship from experienced senior developers and collaboration with international stakeholders.
Clear career progression pathways and opportunities to take on greater technical ownership in an Agile environment.

Job Description
We are looking for a Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer with at least 3 years of professional experience to work on client projects involving web applications, API integrations, and AI-powered business workflows.
Key Requirements
At least 3 years of professional full-stack development experience.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript and React.
Backend development experience with Node.js, RESTful APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Supabase, including authentication and database operations.
Working knowledge of PHP and WordPress for maintaining and extending existing websites.
Familiarity with OpenAI or Claude APIs and workflow automation using n8n, Make, or Zapier.
Good understanding of responsive design, debugging, performance optimization, and application security.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub, deployment, and testing changes before release.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and follow technical guidance.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Laravel, Stripe integrations, or CRM automation.
Familiarity with Cursor, Claude Code, or similar development tools, including reviewing and testing generated code.
How to Apply
Apply using the button on this page, apply through Indeed, or send your updated CV to hr@hboxdigital.com.
